About Us

Muhurta Foundation

Muhurta Foundation is a non-profit, irrevocable and wholly public charitable trust. It was created by a Deed of Trust on 16 May 2023 and works for everyone, irrespective of caste, creed, colour, community or religion.

Our motto is Let's make a better tomorrow. We work on a strict “no profit, no loss” basis, and every trustee serves without remuneration.

Registration details
Trust Deed No. 190200929 of 2023 under the Indian Trust Act 1882, registered by ARA-II, Kolkata.
NGO Darpan (NITI Aayog) Regn. No. WB/2023/0347744.
VIPNET (Dept. of Science & Technology, Govt. of India) Regn. No. VP-WB0131.

What we work for

The main aims and objects of the trust

Education and culture

Schools, coaching, training and study centres, scholarships, books and libraries.

Relief to the poor

Food, clothes, uniforms, books and shelter for people in need and those hit by natural calamities.

Health and medical relief

Blood donation and testing camps, eye camps, first aid, medical help and health awareness.

Research and innovation

Support for research in science, arts, technology, management, law and healthcare.

Career and skills

Career consultation, vocational training, computer education and self-employment support.

Environment

Tree plantation, afforestation and awareness about natural resources.

Women empowerment

Raising the status of women through education, awareness, literacy and training.

Sports

Promotion of sports, including rural sports and training.
